summary.headline: Choice Health At Home secures $534K in annual savings across 5 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ sourcing program for Choice Health At Home has delivered $534,477 in validated annual savings to-date. A new contract with McKesson is already executed, locking in $276K (21%) savings on Medical Supplies. A further $258K is in the pipeline from Fleet maintenance fee reductions, Temp staffing rate negotiations and an office-supply GPO shift. Work began in February 2024 and the first contract was finalized in July, with remaining categories moving through signature and negotiation.
